integrity: The exact formula is proved from equality partitions, independent order extensions, Fraisse extension, and quantifier elimination; dp-rank bounds are proved separately from ICT patterns and type growth. Finite checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Pure generic multi-orders only; no claim for expansions, reducts, imaginaries, or infinite parameter sets. Originality retains an explicit unindexed-folklore risk.
title: Exact finite-parameter type growth and dp-rank of the generic multi-order
